Respirator fit testing

From report photo to signed PDF

Add the event, check the report, get both signatures and save. Watch the walkthrough or follow the eight steps below.

Watch the video · 3 min 13 secOpen PDF guideOpen ENVSS Field

Training example: this walkthrough uses a local demo job and example report data. The screen matches the fit-test workflow; it does not create a real event or report. Have the job number and a clear photo of the PortaCount report ready.

Narrated walkthrough · captions available via CC · Download with captions · Download without captions

ENVSS Field · Fit-test quick guide   /   1 of 4

1Open the job

Open ENVSS Field in Chrome, sign in with your ENVSS Google account, then click the job on the Projects screen. The video uses 0019389, a demo training project.

2Create a fit-testing event

Click New project event. Choose Respirator fit testing, check the date, then click Create event. The app assigns {job}-FIT-001, then FIT-002 and so on.

ENVSS Field · Fit-test quick guide   /   2 of 4

3Upload the TSI report photo

Click Add individual report and choose the PortaCount report photo from Files. Get the whole report in the shot, flat and in focus. Wait a few seconds while the app reads it.

4Check the person, dates and respirator

On the confirm screen, compare every field with the photo. Check the ID, name, company, test and due dates, PortaCount serial number, respirator, model and size. Fix any mistakes before signing.

ENVSS Field · Fit-test quick guide   /   3 of 4

5Check the results

Scroll down and check the protocol, pass level, each exercise, overall fit factor and PASS / FAIL. Check highlighted fields carefully. Signing later? Save without signing makes an unsigned PDF; reopen the report when ready.

6Get both signatures

Click Continue to signatures. The ENVSS technician signs the top box, then the person tested signs the Client box. Use a finger, stylus or trackpad. Use Clear to start again, then click Save signed PDF.

ENVSS Field · Fit-test quick guide   /   4 of 4

7Open the signed PDF

The app downloads a one-page PDF in the TSI report layout, with the ENVSS header and both signatures. It is named Surname_First_Model_DD-MM-YYYY.pdf. Open it from Chrome’s downloads.

8Check Drive and finish the event

The report shows as Signed. Under Files for Drive, look for In Drive. The PDF goes into the Fit-Tests folder in the job’s Field App Drive folder as a new file. Add one report per person, then Mark event complete when everyone has signed.

Before you finish: one report per person, every field checked against the photo, both signatures present, and the PDF showing In Drive. Only mark the event complete when every report is signed.
Read the video transcript

0:00This is a quick guide to recording a respirator fit test in the ENVSS Field app on a Chromebook. You'll need the job number, and a photo of the PortaCount fit test report. The job and names in this video are example data.

0:16Sign in with your ENVSS Google account as usual, then click the job on the Projects screen. We're using job 0 0 1 9 3 8 9.

0:27Click New project event. Under Event type, choose Respirator fit testing, check the date, and click Create event.

0:42The app numbers it for you: the job number, then FIT, then 0 0 1. The next fit-testing event on this job will be FIT 0 0 2.

0:53Now click Add individual report, and choose the photo of the TSI report. On a phone this opens the camera. On the Chromebook, pick the photo from Files. Get the whole report in the shot, flat and in focus.

1:09The app reads the photo with Google Vision. Give it a few seconds, and stay on this screen.

1:16Next is the confirm screen. The photo is on the left, and the fields from the report are filled in on the right: the ID number, name, company, test and due dates, the PortaCount serial number, and the respirator.

1:32Scroll down to check the protocol, pass level, the four exercises, the overall fit factor, and the PASS or FAIL result. Anything the app isn't sure about is highlighted. Check every field against the photo, and fix anything that's wrong. Nothing is signed automatically.

1:51If you can't get signatures straight away, click Save without signing. You'll get an unsigned PDF, and you can open the report later to sign it.

2:02Otherwise, when everything's correct, click Continue to signatures.

2:07The ENVSS technician signs in the top box, with a finger or stylus on a touch screen, or with the trackpad.

2:15Then hand the device to the person who was tested, and they sign in the Client box. Use Clear if you need to start again.

2:25Click Save signed PDF.

2:28The app makes a one page PDF in the TSI report layout, with the ENVSS header and both signatures, and downloads a copy. It's named by surname, first name, mask model and test date.

2:43Back on the event, the report shows as signed. Under Files for Drive, the PDF is copied as a new file into the Fit-Tests folder in the job's Field App Drive folder. Nothing already in the job folder is changed.

2:59Add a report for each person you test. When everyone has signed, click Mark event complete. If you need this guide again, there's a How to link at the bottom of every fit-testing event.
